2.3 Tulis uji properti format Rupiah.failingExample: Property failed after 1 test. Counterexample: [10000000000] (seed: 1075216891, path: "0:1:0:0:0:3:0:2:2:2:0:0:1:0:4:0:1:0:2:0:0:0", shrunk 21 times). formatRupiah(10000000000) = "Rp 10.000.000.000"; parseRupiah("Rp 10.000.000.000") returned null instead of 10000000000. Root cause: parseRupiah's regex `^(-)?\s*Rp\s*(\d(?:\.\d{3})*)$` only allows a single leading digit before the first thousands-separator group, so any amount whose leftmost group has 2 or 3 digits (e.g. 10 milyar, 100 ribu) fails to parse even though formatRupiah produced valid output.
